title: Read a record speed
description: Read the speed on a record label and set the player, or say the player cannot match it.
oneStarDescription: Point to the speed number.
twoStarDescription: Set that speed, or say the player does not have it.
threeStarDescription: Say which speed is ready.

title: Read a repeat sign
description: Point to a repeat sign and say what returns, without performing the music.
oneStarDescription: Point to the repeat dots or the word repeat.
twoStarDescription: Say the section goes back, and point to where if it is marked.
threeStarDescription: Say you have not played it.

title: Read a seed packet
description: Read the plant name, a sowing depth or spacing, and one thing the packet does not promise.
oneStarDescription: Say the plant name on the packet.
twoStarDescription: Read a depth, a spacing, or a date.
threeStarDescription: Say one thing the packet does not tell you about your own soil.

title: Read a shoe size and its limit
description: Read the size printed in a shoe and say that the number is not a promise it will fit.
oneStarDescription: Point to the printed size.
twoStarDescription: Read the number and any width mark.
threeStarDescription: Say you would still try the shoe, because the number is not the fit.

title: Read one knitting symbol
description: Point to one symbol on a knitting chart and say the stitch the legend gives.
oneStarDescription: Point to the legend. A second person can see that this step happened: find the legend.
twoStarDescription: Match one symbol in the chart to the legend.
threeStarDescription: Say you have not knitted the row.

title: Tell a reed from an open mouthpiece
description: Point to a reed mouthpiece and a lip-blown open mouthpiece, or say you can see only one.
oneStarDescription: Point to a mouthpiece you may look at.
twoStarDescription: Say reed or open, from what you see.
threeStarDescription: Find the other, or write that you saw only one.

title: Reverse a cushion
description: Turn a cushion over or around and say what that hid.
oneStarDescription: Point to the worn or faded face.
twoStarDescription: Turn it so another face shows.
threeStarDescription: Say what is now hidden. A second person can see that this step happened: say what changed.

title: Roll a clay slab with an even edge
description: Roll a clay slab and show that two edges are close to the same thickness.
oneStarDescription: Roll the clay between guides or with even pressure.
twoStarDescription: Pinch or look at two edges and say if one is much thicker.
threeStarDescription: Roll again or say you will leave the thin spot.

title: Rotate a photo upright
description: Rotate a sideways photo until the subject is upright, and do not crop it.
oneStarDescription: Say which way the subject leans.
twoStarDescription: Rotate it upright. A second person can see that this step happened: rotate.
threeStarDescription: Show that you did not cut the subject off.

title: Tell a round arch from a pointed arch
description: Point to an arch and say whether the top is round or pointed.
oneStarDescription: Point to an arch from the street.
twoStarDescription: Say round or pointed. A second person can see that this step happened: name the top.
threeStarDescription: Find the other kind, or write that this street showed only one.

title: Name the season clues on one tree
description: From one tree, say which season clues you can see, such as bare twigs, flowers, full leaves, or fruit.
oneStarDescription: Point to one tree. A second person can see that this step happened: choose the tree.
twoStarDescription: Name the clues you can see, not a date.
threeStarDescription: Say one clue you do not see.

title: See which way the water moves
description: From the bank, say which way a leaf or a stick on the water travels.
oneStarDescription: Point to a leaf or a stick already in the water.
twoStarDescription: Watch it pass one landmark.
threeStarDescription: Point downstream of your landmark, or say the water was still.

title: Tell serif from sans serif
description: Point to a serif letter and a sans-serif letter on signs or a page.
oneStarDescription: Point to a letter with small feet.
twoStarDescription: Point to a letter without those feet.
threeStarDescription: Say which of two signs is which.

title: Set a chessboard to the start
description: Set the starting chess position and say which corner holds a light square on the right.
oneStarDescription: Put the light square at the right of the nearer row.
twoStarDescription: Place the pieces in the starting squares.
threeStarDescription: Read one side's pieces from the corner and fix one error, or say it was right.

title: Set a thermostat and set it back
description: Change a thermostat by one step, read the new number, and set it back.
oneStarDescription: Write the number before you change it.
twoStarDescription: Change it by one step the control allows.
threeStarDescription: Return it to the first number.

title: Set an eyelet in scrap
description: Punch a hole in scrap and set an eyelet so a lace can pass through.
oneStarDescription: Punch the hole on scrap, away from your hand.
twoStarDescription: Set it so it holds. A second person can see that this step happened: set the eyelet.
threeStarDescription: Pass a lace or a string through and tug.

title: Sew a French knot
description: Sew one French knot that stays raised, then two more in a row.
oneStarDescription: Wrap and pull one knot so it sits on the cloth.
twoStarDescription: Point to the wrap, not a plain stitch.
threeStarDescription: Sew two more and show they are separate.

title: Sew a hook and eye
description: Sew a hook and an eye on two scraps so they catch.
oneStarDescription: Line up the hook and the eye.
twoStarDescription: Sew each so the stitches hold.
threeStarDescription: Hook them and tug lightly.

title: Sew a snap so it closes
description: Sew one half of a snap to scrap cloth and show that it can meet the other half.
oneStarDescription: Pin or hold the snap on the cloth.
twoStarDescription: Sew through the holes without sewing the cloth shut.
threeStarDescription: Press it to the other half, or say you sewed only one half and it lies flat.

title: Photograph one object in shade and sun
description: Photograph the same object in shade and in sun and say what the light changed.
oneStarDescription: Take the shade photo. A second person can see that this step happened: shoot the shade.
twoStarDescription: Take the sunlit photo without aiming at the sun.
threeStarDescription: Say what happened to the shadow or the color.

title: Shelve three books by call number
description: Put three books in call-number order and say where a fourth number would go.
oneStarDescription: Read the three call numbers.
twoStarDescription: Put the books in that order.
threeStarDescription: Say whether a fourth number would fall before, between, or after them.

title: Tell a simple leaf from a compound leaf
description: Say whether one leaf stalk holds one blade or several leaflets.
oneStarDescription: Follow one stalk back to the twig.
twoStarDescription: Say one blade or several leaflets.
threeStarDescription: Look for a bud at the base of the whole leaf, and say if you cannot see one.

title: Sketch a door and its hinge side
description: Sketch a door and mark the side the hinges are on.
oneStarDescription: Stand where you can see the hinge or the hinge gap.
twoStarDescription: Sketch the rectangle and the handle.
threeStarDescription: Mark the hinge side and check it once more.

title: Tell a slide brass from valves
description: From a photo or an instrument you may look at, say whether the brass instrument uses a slide or valves.
oneStarDescription: Point to the slide or the valves.
twoStarDescription: Say slide or valves. A second person can see that this step happened: name it.
threeStarDescription: Say you are not naming the piece of music.

title: Sort a shelf by a rule you wrote
description: Write one sorting rule, sort a short shelf by it, and find one item by that rule.
oneStarDescription: Write the rule before you move things.
twoStarDescription: Put at least five items in that order.
threeStarDescription: Have someone name an item and find it with the rule.

title: Sort shells by one feature
description: Sort empty shells by one feature you name, such as ridged or smooth.
oneStarDescription: Write the feature before you sort.
twoStarDescription: Sort at least six, or all you have.
threeStarDescription: Set aside one that does not fit and say why.

title: Spot a duplicate in a list
description: Find one repeated entry in a list you wrote, or say the list has none.
oneStarDescription: Write at least eight lines, including one repeat if you plan one.
twoStarDescription: Point to the two lines that match, or say there is no repeat.
threeStarDescription: Cross out the extra line or say you will keep both and why.

title: Spot a palindrome
description: Find or write a word or short phrase that reads the same forward and back.
oneStarDescription: Write a palindrome. A second person can see that this step happened: show one.
twoStarDescription: Read it backward and show it matches.
threeStarDescription: Show a word that almost works and say where it fails.

title: Tell landscape from portrait orientation
description: Say whether a frame is wider than it is tall, and turn one photo to the other orientation.
oneStarDescription: Say landscape or portrait for one frame.
twoStarDescription: Point to the longer side.
threeStarDescription: Turn a photo you may edit to the other orientation and say what got cut, or that nothing did.

title: Tell a QR code from a barcode
description: Point to a QR code and a barcode and say what each is for in one sentence.
oneStarDescription: Show one of each, or a photo of each.
twoStarDescription: Say the QR code can open a link and the barcode is a product number.
threeStarDescription: Say you are not checking whether the link is safe.

title: Tell a butterfly from a moth
description: Use one feature you can see, and a chart, to say butterfly, moth, or not sure.
oneStarDescription: Point to the resting insect or a clear photo.
twoStarDescription: Name the feature you used, such as the feelers or the wing rest.
threeStarDescription: Say what you could not see, and stop if the chart does not fit.

title: Tell the right side of a cloth
description: Point to the side of a cloth that is meant to show, and say the clue.
oneStarDescription: Turn the cloth over. A second person can see that this step happened: look at both.
twoStarDescription: Say the clue, such as a print, a sheen, or a finished edge.
threeStarDescription: Mark the right side with a pin or a note.

title: Tell dew from rain on a leaf
description: Say whether water on a leaf is dew or rain, and what clue you used.
oneStarDescription: Point to water on a leaf or a dry leaf if there is none.
twoStarDescription: Say whether the ground around it is wet or only the leaf is beaded.
threeStarDescription: Say dew or rain, and one case where you would not be sure.

title: Tell frost from dew
description: Say whether a white or wet coating is ice or liquid water, and how you can tell.
oneStarDescription: Point to it without scraping a plant bare.
twoStarDescription: Touch one spot or watch whether it wets a finger.
threeStarDescription: Say frost or dew, or that you are not sure.

title: Tell a knit stitch from a purl
description: On a knitted sample, point to a smooth stitch and a bumpy stitch.
oneStarDescription: Point to a V-shaped stitch.
twoStarDescription: Point to a bump on the other side or the same row.
threeStarDescription: Use a chart's words and say if the sample does not match.

title: Tell a left glove from a right
description: Put two gloves in a pair and say which is the left.
oneStarDescription: Point to both thumbs. A second person can see that this step happened: find the thumbs.
twoStarDescription: Put them so the thumbs face each other when the palms are down.
threeStarDescription: Say which glove is the left.

title: Tell moss from lichen
description: Point to moss and lichen, or say you found only one.
oneStarDescription: Point to a green or gray patch on bark or stone.
twoStarDescription: Call it moss or lichen and name the clue, such as leaves or a crust.
threeStarDescription: Find the other, or write that this place showed only one.

title: Tell a still moment from motion blur
description: Point to a sharp subject and a blurred moving part in a photo, or say the photo is all sharp.
oneStarDescription: Look at the photo. A second person can see that this step happened: look.
twoStarDescription: Point to blur or say there is none.
threeStarDescription: Say what looks as if it moved, without inventing a speed.

title: Tell a portrait from a still life
description: Say whether a picture is mainly a person or mainly objects, and point to the clue.
oneStarDescription: Look at the picture. A second person can see that this step happened: look.
twoStarDescription: Say portrait or still life.
threeStarDescription: Point to the face or the objects that decided it.

title: Tell a sewn binding from a glued one
description: Open a book and say whether you can see threads in the gutter or only glue.
oneStarDescription: Open the book at the middle.
twoStarDescription: Say whether you see stitches.
threeStarDescription: Say sewn, glued, or not sure.
